rationale: pp-003 is the strongest match because it directly demonstrates DevSecOps pipeline implementation and AWS GovCloud migration experience, both of which are explicitly called out in the Army PEO C3T opportunity's scope for DevSecOps continuous delivery pipelines and IL4/IL5 cloud environment proficiency. pp-005 was selected as the second featured entry because it is the only other DoD-sector entry in the library, providing Defense Health Agency program management and IV&V support — the opportunity explicitly requests IV&V of migrated network configurations, and DoD familiarity (including compliance documentation and RMF-adjacent work) is a meaningful signal. No third entry was featured because pp-001, pp-002, and pp-004 are all federal civilian modernization efforts with no DoD nexus, no tactical communications relevance, no software-defined networking or spectrum management experience, and no RMF/cybersecurity alignment at the Secret/IL4-IL5 level required by this Army tactical network modernization effort. pp-001 was demoted because while it demonstrates cloud migration, its IRS tax analytics context shares no mission-domain or technical overlap with Army tactical communications infrastructure.
